shortDescription: According to Wallstreetcn, U.S. President Donald Trump said the United States had just reached an oil deal with Venezuela and had obtained majority control of Venezuela's more than 65 billion barrels of proven oil reserves.

title: U.S. President Donald Trump Says U.S. Reached Oil Deal With Venezuela
